description: This file implements a Webhook handler and WebSocket server for real-time voice call processing, including token management, call registration, and media streaming via WebSocket, within a voice call system.

classes.name: RealtimeCallHandler
classes.description: Handles real-time voice call WebSocket connections, token management, call registration, and media streaming.

methods.name: setPublicUrl
methods.description: Sets the public URL and updates path prefix accordingly.

methods.name: getStreamPathPattern
methods.description: Returns the URL pattern for the voice stream.

methods.name: buildTwiMLPayload
methods.description: Builds a TwiML XML response with WebSocket URL for call streaming.

methods.name: handleWebSocketUpgrade
methods.description: Handles WebSocket upgrade requests, authenticates tokens, and manages media data exchange.

methods.name: registerToolHandler
methods.description: Registers a tool handler function by name.

methods.name: issueStreamToken
methods.description: Generates a temporary stream token with expiry.

methods.name: consumeStreamToken
methods.description: Consumes and validates a stream token.

methods.name: handleCall
methods.description: Handles an incoming call, creates a media bridge, and manages call lifecycle events.

methods.name: registerCallInManager
methods.description: Registers call details with the call manager.

methods.name: extractInitialGreeting
methods.description: Extracts initial greeting message from call metadata.

methods.name: endCallInManager
methods.description: Marks call as ended in the call manager.

methods.name: executeToolCall
methods.description: Executes a registered tool call and submits the result.
